name: Miranda, Princess at Heart
source:
Miranda Kelley is a junior in high school who often stays home alone because her parents are busy working in the entertainment industry. When she accidentally breaks their favorite glass, they hire a babysitter who isn't what she expects.

[From [url=https://sites.google.com/site/mirandaprincessatheart/home/part-1]official site[/url]]
translation:
米兰达·凯利是一名高中生，因为父母忙于娱乐圈的工作，她经常独自待在家里。她不小心打碎父母最喜欢的玻璃杯后，父母请来了一名保姆，而这个人并不像她所想的那样。

[来自 [url=https://sites.google.com/site/mirandaprincessatheart/home/part-1]官方网站[/url]]
